primary_negative_control.expected: Unknown contract versions are rejected before mutation instead of being accepted/coerced.

positive_evidence: contracts.test.ts covers non-finite numbers, confidence outside 0..1, non-positive/non-integer DB IDs, empty/duplicate IDs, anchor bounds, locale rules, explicit units, physical bases and evidence ownership.

primary_negative_control.procedure: Exercise invalid confidence, invalid DB IDs, empty/duplicate evidence IDs, invalid anchors, unsupported explicit locale fallback, grams+milliliters simultaneously, and cross-domain evidence references.
primary_negative_control.expected: Each malformed dimension is rejected while valid sibling cases remain accepted.
primary_negative_control.observed: Exact-head contract tests reject unsupported explicit locale fallback and evidence references that belong to another owner/domain, in addition to the prior validation matrix.
